title: Масштабна фішингова атака на державні установи України 19.01.2021

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe whose government institutions were targeted in the phishing campaign.

entities.name: Адміністрація Держспецзв’язку
entities.gloss: The State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection of Ukraine, impersonated in the phishing emails.

entities.name: zapros@dsszzi.gov.ua
entities.gloss: A spoofed email address used as the sender address in the phishing campaign.
An IP address belonging to Vimpelcom from which the phishing emails were distributed.

entities.name: Vimpelcom
entities.gloss: A Russian telecommunications service provider owning the IP address used for sending phishing emails.

entities.name: Російська Федерація
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia where the phishing email sender's IP address originated.

entities.name: Електронний запит.rar
entities.gloss: A malicious RAR archive attachment containing a password-protected archive and password.

entities.name: Електронний запит.exe
entities.gloss: A remote access trojan executable unpacked from the malicious archive.

entities.name: installer.exe
entities.gloss: An installer executable dropped by the trojan to deploy Remote Utilities.

entities.name: host_news_mod_mod.msi
entities.gloss: A malicious MSI installer package dropped and executed by the trojan.

entities.name: Remote Utilities
entities.gloss: A legitimate remote desktop software product abused by attackers for unauthorized remote access.

entities.name: killself.bat
entities.gloss: A batch script used to delete indicators of compromise from working directories after malware initialization.

entities.name: RMS
entities.gloss: Remote Manipulator System, a remote administration software package deployed by the malware.
A command-and-control server IP address contacted by the deployed malware.

relations.evidence: ІР-адреси 212.44.151.60, яка належить до пулу адрес провайдера "Vimpelcom"

relations.head: Електронний запит.exe
relations.evidence: «Електронний запит.ехе» містить в собі файли «installer.exe» та «host_news_mod_mod.msi»

relations.head: installer.exe
relations.evidence: «installer.exe» є старою версією легального програмного забезпечення для віддаленого доступу Remote Utilities

relations.head: Електронний запит.exe
relations.evidence: видаляють індикатори компрометації з робочих директорій ШПЗ за допомогою файлу «killself.bat»
